translations.web: Your plunder will be gathered as the caterpillar gathers. Men will leap on it as locusts leap.
translations.bsb: Your spoil, O nations, is gathered as by locusts; like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it.
translations.kjv: And your spoil shall be gathered like the gathering of the caterpiller: as the running to and fro of locusts shall he run
translations.asv: And your spoil shall be gathered as the caterpillar gathereth: as locusts leap shall men leap upon it.
